paper_title: An analysis of vaccine-related sentiments from development to deployment   of COVID-19 vaccines
caption: : Caption not extracted
model_annotation: This line plot illustrates the distribution of counts of vaccine-related sentiments, categorized by their polarity scores, ranging from -1.0 to 0.6. The x-axis, labeled “Polarity scores,” uses a linear scale and is marked at intervals of 0.2, with values spanning from -1.0 to 0.6. The y-axis, labeled “Counts,” also uses a linear scale and ranges from 0 to 8000. A single blue line with circular markers connects data points across the x-axis, showing a general increase in counts as polarity scores approach zero. The counts begin at approximately 0 for a polarity score of -1.0, rise gradually to about 3000 at a polarity score of -0.2, and reach a peak of approximately 9000 at a polarity score of 0.0. Following this peak, the counts decline to approximately 3000 at a polarity score of 0.2, then drop further to approximately 2000 at 0.4, before rising slightly to about 1500 at 0.5 and falling back to 0 at 0.6.
